rationale: The plan correctly recognizes that STAR/featureCounts integer counts go straight into DESeqDataSetFromMatrix with no tximport and no length offset, and it says so explicitly; the edgeR QL cross-check is a reasonable, design-appropriate addition for n=3/group. QC (VST PCA on top-500 variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes colored by condition) precedes the test with a stated flag-don't-drop outlier policy, the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group size) is minimal and justified, and normalization is left internal with an explicit prohibition on pre-scaling. The design formula ~condition, explicit control reference level, named contrast, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage, and separate reporting of Cook's-flagged vs filtered NAs are all specified in the test rather than post hoc. Enrichment was not asked for and is arguably beyond scope, but it is specified well (full ranked list on the Wald statistic, named collections with versions, 15-500 size window, collapsePathways, leading edge); the only wobble is mapping symbols to Entrez via org.Hs.eg.db when both GMTs are symbol-based, an unnecessary and lossy step. The final report names methods, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, and the low-power caveat.
